title: NetProbe: single-clock correlation of delay, throughput, load and packet evidence
description: NetProbe is an open-source Python tool and library for Linux that runs delay (RTT, RFC 3550 jitter, loss), TCP throughput, rate-limited load and packet capture concurrently and records every observation in one schema stamped by one monotonic clock. A deterministic analysis reports load phases, congestion onset and the capture frames behind it.
